primary_api_checks.finding: put(skip_if_exists=True) returns whether inserted; documented entries expire after seven inactive days.
from_id references a deployed or running function by observed ID; hydration is lazy.

cpu tuple is request/hard limit; memory tuple is MiB request/hard limit; single-use containers shut down after one input. These configured semantics do not replace actual terminal/billing observations.

budget.qualification: Reservations and nominal rate estimates are local accounting, not provider-enforced dollar caps. Do not release prior reservations or infer zero charge from lagging billing. Shared allocation covers build/CPU/deploy/benchmark; no extra verification GPU call or idle pool.

test_evidence: Harness author reports15 pure tests and parent author reports16 exact-source fake lifecycle cases passed. Reviewer inspected harness test source (batch atomicity, clear/ref revalidation, done/native timer, fatal inference, planned denominator and selection); did not rerun either suite.
runtime_gates: Fresh exact CPU preflight must succeed without retry before GPU.
Observed private deployment app/function/source identity must be saved; no inferred success from source declarations.
Actual completed/incomplete results, call counters and terminal/container/billing observations must be retained.
limits: Only12 families×2 fixed seeds, restricted native actions and DOM assistance. No full MiniWoB, OSWorld, pixel-only, Astra parity orworld-best claim.
Native10-second outcomes combine decision quality and inference latency. CPU fingerprint admission and runtime pinning may fail; source review cannot predict their pass.
Fixed two-seed task content may be present in model pretraining; no unseen-data claim.
Direct browser close may suppress quit errors; no independent descendant inventory. Normal direct child exit is not settled GPU billing.
This private one-shot benchmark verifies a hosted reconstruction, not an ongoing interactive inference endpoint.
Protocol invalid-action endings and infrastructure aborts are distinguishable; never hide missing cases in a completed-only success denominator.
